symptom: every `mxcli test` run prints 2x MDL-DEPR001 and 2x MDL-V1-SLASH about a script the user never wrote
cause: GenerateEndpointMDL emitted a headerless mdl 0 script with `create or replace` and `/` terminators; the test-flow generators had already moved to the version-aware writeScriptHeader/createFlow/writeFlowEnd
fix: GenerateEndpointMDL writes mdl 1 through the same helpers (header, create or modify, `;` only); endpoint script is independent of the suite's version
insight: A generated script is checked like a user's one; pin it with a test that parses it and asserts ValidateProgram returns nothing. Verified end to end with `mxcli test --local` on a fresh 11.13 app
